newsitem.title: UK: RESEARCH ALERT - Nokia earnings raised.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Nokia earnings raised.

text.p: JP Morgan upwardly revised its estimates for second quarter profit before taxes and full-year earnings per share for Nokia Oy, the investment bank said on Thursday.
The second quarter profit estimate was raised to FIM 1.67 billion, from its previous forecast of 1.56 billion, it said.
The full-year EPS target was raised to 17.3 from its earlier estimate of 16.7.
JP Morgan retained its "buy" rating with a new price target of FIM 500. Shares on Thursday were trading up 1 at 468.50.
A Reuters survey puts the median forecast for Nokia for the second quarter at 1.64 billion markka.
"A potentially better-than-expected performance at Nokia Mobile Phones in Q2 1997 is the principal reason for the upgrade to our overall forecast," said Sean Faughnan at JP Morgan.

The analyst said Nokia could well beat market expectations, even though a recent increase in the share price has been "underpinned by a series of upward revisions in analysts' forecasts" for the second quarter and year.
